title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3  billion round led by Bessemer.
title_es: Fal duplica su valoración a $16B con ronda de $1.3B
bajada: La startup de inferencia de IA Fal alcanzó una valoración de $16 mil millones tras recaudar $1.3 mil millones liderados por Bessemer. El movimiento refleja la demanda creciente en el mercado de inferencia de IA, un segmento crítico para la ejecución eficiente de modelos en producción.
bajada_en: AI inference startup Fal reached a $16 billion valuation after raising $1.3 billion led by Bessemer. The move reflects surging demand in the inference market, a critical segment for efficient model execution in production environments.

title: Synopsys, Cadence Shares Drop 4% on The Information Report
summary: Shares of Synopsys and Cadence Design Systems dropped as much as 4% on Tuesday afterThe Information reportedthat Anthropic has told investors that it is using its own Claude models for engineering and design work on its custom chips.Anthropic’s engineers found that Claude cuts down the time ...
title_es: Anthropic usa Claude interno, afectando acciones de Synopsys y Cadence
bajada: Las acciones de Synopsys y Cadence cayeron 4% tras reportarse que Anthropic utiliza Claude para trabajo de ingeniería y diseño de chips personalizados, reduciendo significativamente el tiempo de ejecución. El cambio sugiere que los modelos de IA están desplazando herramientas especializadas incluso en dominios complejos como chip design.
bajada_en: Shares of Synopsys and Cadence dropped 4% after reports that Anthropic uses Claude for engineering and design work on custom chips, significantly reducing execution time. The shift suggests AI models are displacing specialized tools even in complex domains like chip design.

title: Canva Lays Off Workers After AI Rollout Problems
summary: Canva is making its first round of job cuts since it was founded in 2013, the Australian Financial Review first reported on Tuesday. The company has told 22% of its staff, or 1,271 people, that they need to change roles, relocate, or lose their jobs.“We’re simplifying layers, consolidating ...
title_es: Canva despide al 22% de su plantilla tras problemas en rollout de IA
bajada: Canva comenzó su primer ciclo de despidos desde 2013, afectando a 1,271 empleados (22% de su equipo) tras dificultades en la implementación de sus características de IA. La acción evidencia los desafíos que enfrentan las empresas tradicionales al integrar IA en sus productos.
bajada_en: Canva launched its first layoffs since 2013, affecting 1,271 employees (22% of staff) following difficulties implementing AI features. The move highlights challenges traditional companies face when integrating AI into their products.

title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
summary: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.
title_es: OpenAI muestra integración de ChatGPT en workflows de ingeniería física
bajada: OpenAI publicó casos de uso de ChatGPT y Codex acelerando tareas de CAD, diseño PCB y simulación para ingenieros. La iniciativa posiciona a OpenAI como actor importante en herramientas para ingeniería profesional, un mercado tradicional dominado por software especializado.
bajada_en: OpenAI published use cases of ChatGPT and Codex accelerating CAD, PCB design, and simulation tasks for engineers. The initiative positions OpenAI as a key player in professional engineering tools, a market traditionally dominated by specialized software.

title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
title_es: Anthropic desarrolla FlashProve para verificar identidad de modelos IA
bajada: Anthropic está construyendo FlashProve, un sistema que permite a cualquiera verificar que una respuesta de IA proviene realmente del modelo que lo afirma. La herramienta aborda un problema crítico de seguridad y confianza en entornos donde la identificación del modelo es esencial.
bajada_en: Anthropic is building FlashProve, a system enabling anyone to verify that an AI response actually came from the claimed model. The tool addresses a critical security and trust problem in environments where model identity verification is essential.

title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
summary: Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps. As part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday, Apple announced developers can now integrate Siri AI's new features in "all apps," allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user's personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on-screen awareness to […]
title_es: Apple expande Siri AI a aplicaciones de terceros en iOS 27.3
bajada: Apple permitió que desarrolladores integren las nuevas capacidades de Siri AI en cualquier aplicación, dándole acceso a contexto personal del usuario y conciencia de pantalla. Este cambio abre un ecosistema de integraciones de IA similar al de OpenAI con GPTs.
bajada_en: Apple enabled developers to integrate Siri AI's new features in any app, giving it access to user personal context and on-screen awareness. This shift opens an AI integration ecosystem similar to OpenAI's GPT ecosystem.

title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
summary: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules. As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are scrambling to ensure they are “aligned” with human desires—to make sure, in other words, that rogue agents don’t break the law,…
title_es: Teoría de juegos inversa como mecanismo para alinear agentes IA
bajada: Investigadores del MIT proponen "teoría de juegos inversa" para controlar modelos IA poderosos mediante sistemas que incentiven el cumplimiento de reglas. Es una aproximación prometedora a la alineación de IA que interesa a safety researchers.
bajada_en: MIT researchers propose "reverse game theory" to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize rule compliance. A promising approach to AI alignment gaining traction among safety researchers.

title: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
title_es: Postman auto-instala plugins de IA sin consentimiento explícito
bajada: Usuarios reportaron que Postman auto-instala plugins de IA e intenta compartir datos de APIs sin consentimiento explícito. El incidente plantea preocupaciones sobre privacidad y prácticas de sombra en herramientas developer de amplio uso.
bajada_en: Users reported Postman auto-installing AI plugins and attempting to share API data without explicit consent. The incident raises privacy concerns and questions about shadowy practices in widely-used developer tools.

title: Google researchers demand freedom to tell the world what they know about AI
title_es: Investigadores de Google exigen libertad para criticar políticas de IA
bajada: Empleados de Google DeepMind protestaron contra restricciones de por vida que les impiden criticar públicamente a la empresa sobre IA. El movimiento refleja tensiones internas sobre libertad de expresión y supervisión de IA en grandes empresas tech.
bajada_en: Google DeepMind employees protested lifetime restrictions preventing them from publicly criticizing the company on AI matters. The movement reflects internal tensions over free speech and AI oversight at major tech companies.

title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
summary: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.
title_es: OpenAI presentó Pando, backend Git escalable para desarrollo con Codex
bajada: OpenAI desarrolló Pando, un backend compatible con Git diseñado para manejar la escala de desarrollo que Codex posibilita. La herramienta es relevante para developers trabajando con modelos de generación de código a gran escala.
bajada_en: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed to handle development at the scale Codex enables. The tool is relevant for developers working with large-scale code generation models.

title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
summary: Cities generate enormous amounts of data from cameras, sensors and operational systems, but turning it into useful action — for planning, maintenance and public services — remains a challenge. Physical and agentic AI offer new ways to close that gap, from digital twins for infrastructure planning to vision and service agents, while keeping local governments […]
title_es: NVIDIA impulsa IA física y agentes en ciudades inteligentes
bajada: NVIDIA presentó aplicaciones de IA física y agentes para que ciudades transformen datos de cámaras y sensores en acciones. Los gemelos digitales e inyecciones de visión por computadora prometen mejorar planificación urbana y servicios públicos.
bajada_en: NVIDIA showcased physical AI and agentic AI applications for cities to transform camera and sensor data into actionable intelligence. Digital twins and computer vision agents promise to improve urban planning and public services.

title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
summary: Demand for advanced chips is rising. The processes to build them are getting more complex. And the margin for error is shrinking. For engineers, understanding how a process change will behave, how a material will interact with a new step, how a defect maps back to a root cause are critical, challenging steps in semiconductor […]
title_es: IA acelera procesos en fábricas de semiconductores de NVIDIA
bajada: NVIDIA documentó cómo la IA está optimizando procesos de manufactura de chips, mejorando comprensión de cambios de proceso y rastreo de defectos. Con la demanda de chips avanzados en alza, la IA se vuelve crítica para mantener márgenes en fabricación.
bajada_en: NVIDIA documented how AI is optimizing chip manufacturing processes, improving process change understanding and defect root cause analysis. With rising demand for advanced chips, AI becomes critical for maintaining fab margins.

title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
summary: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.
title_es: Cisco y OpenAI integran IA para defensa cibernética empresarial
bajada: Cisco combinó inteligencia de red con modelos OpenAI para fortalecer seguridad empresarial con defensas adaptativas. El caso de uso muestra tracción de modelos OpenAI en seguridad corporativa, un mercado crítico.
bajada_en: Cisco combined network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security with adaptive defenses. The use case demonstrates traction of OpenAI models in corporate security, a critical market.

title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
title_es: StateBench: herramienta de Hugging Face para evaluar seguimiento de estado
bajada: Hugging Face y Allen AI lanzaron StateBench para medir cómo los modelos de lenguaje rastrean cambios de estado en documentos largos. La herramienta es útil para developers evaluando modelos en tareas complejas con dependencias de contexto.
bajada_en: Hugging Face and Allen AI launched StateBench to measure how language models track state changes across long documents. The tool is useful for developers evaluating models on complex tasks with context dependencies.

title: The biggest modding site in PC gaming is taking a stance on AI
summary: The PC gaming mods repository Nexus Mods is making disclosures about AI mandatory for uploads of new mods, meaning that mod authors will have to declare "whether AI has been used in their work," the site announced today as part of a big post about AI-generated content on the platform. "One of the most consistent […]
title_es: Nexus Mods exige divulgación de uso de IA en nuevos mods
bajada: Nexus Mods, el repositorio más grande de mods para PC gaming, hizo obligatoria la declaración del uso de IA en nuevas subidas. La decisión refleja una tensión creciente en comunidades creativas sobre la transparencia y el impacto de contenido generado por IA.
bajada_en: Nexus Mods, the largest PC gaming mod repository, made AI disclosure mandatory for new uploads. The decision reflects growing tension in creative communities about transparency and impact of AI-generated content.
